# Altered Gamer — Lend Me Your Bow

- Original source: [Altered Gamer — Lend Me Your Bow](https://www.alteredgamer.com/other-games/21228-lend-me-your-bow-robin-hood-legend-of-sherwood-review/)
- Author / publication: Altered Gamer; author not verified
- Language / date: English; 2008-12-26
- Access: Article text inspected
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

This retrospective rates the game 4/5 overall. It particularly values the choice between stealth and fighting, the variety of distractions and disabling tools, and the connection between nonlethal play and recruitment.

The author finds the mouse-directed combat gestures inventive but unnecessary. Graphics receive a weaker assessment than the gameplay, although the environments remain pleasant. The article is useful for separating later player expectations from launch-era reviews: its judgment weighs modest hardware requirements and tactical variety more heavily than visual sophistication.

Specific mission-count and restriction claims are the reviewer's account, not independently verified campaign rules.
